comments.devDependencies: Build-only tools: the bundler, its transform, and the three minifiers. They are separated from dependencies because they are not part of anything that runs or ships to a browser, and because browserify carries elliptic (GHSA-848j-6mx2-7j84, for which no patched version exists) through crypto-browserify. Nothing bundled requires elliptic any more — tests/jwk_pem.js is what holds that — so the advisory now describes a build tool only, and `npm audit --omit=dev` says so. Both images install with plain `npm ci`, which includes these, so the build is unaffected.
